title: Redwood Controls quality-of-earnings normalization
prompt:
Prepare Redwood Controls' LTM quality-of-earnings bridge for investment committee.

Use the July corporate-development investment-committee correspondence, the 7/5 controller-tied IC book, the current data-room export, the diligence review notes, and the approved underwriting policy. Treat the 6/29 banker case as change history only.

Rebuild LTM revenue and reported EBITDA from Redwood's twelve-month target P&L. Treat the seller's headline adjustment amounts as proposals, independently size each item from the compensation, settlement, vacancy, procurement, and facility evidence, and reconcile the seller-adjusted case to supported normalized EBITDA. Show the supported adjustment amounts, accepted and rejected names, EBITDA gap, and enterprise-value implication at the working entry multiple.

Keep residual risk separate from normalized QoE. Rank the remaining risks by probability-weighted EBITDA impact, identify the largest, aggregate the expected downside, and show the resulting risk-adjusted EBITDA and margin as an IC diagnostic.

Do not modify files or post transactions. Return only one JSON object with exactly these keys: `ltm_revenue`, `reported_ebitda`, `seller_proposed_adjustments`, `seller_adjusted_ebitda`, `owner_compensation_adjustment`, `legal_settlement_adjustment`, `vacant_cfo_adjustment`, `accepted_adjustments`, `rejected_adjustments`, `net_accepted_adjustments`, `normalized_ebitda`, `normalized_ebitda_margin`, `seller_to_underwriting_ebitda_gap`, `working_entry_multiple`, `seller_to_underwriting_enterprise_value_gap`, `largest_remaining_qoe_risk`, `largest_risk_expected_impact`, `aggregate_probability_weighted_risk`, `risk_adjusted_ebitda`, `risk_adjusted_ebitda_margin`. Use dollars to two decimals, ratios and percentages as decimal ratios to at least four decimals, and lists as JSON arrays.
